findings.evidence: `rg` hits: line 55, 94, 102 use `(hρ : ∀ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ → ...)`; line 65 calls `ContractableLaw.map_reindex hρ hφ`, line 97 calls `ContractableLaw.measurePreserving_shift hρ`, and line 105 calls `ContractableLaw.measurePreserving_shift_iterate hρ n`.
findings.fix: State these lemmas with `(hρ : ContractableLaw ρ)` and use the named projection/measure-preserving lemmas from that hypothesis; keep the unfolded forall only in `intro`/`contractableLaw_iff`.
findings.issue: `ContractableLaw.map_reindex`, `ContractableLaw.map_shift`, and `ContractableLaw.map_shift_iterate` take the raw forall defining `ContractableLaw`; lines 65, 97, and 105 then rely on Lean unfolding that wrapper when passing `hρ` to lemmas expecting `ContractableLaw ρ`.

summary: The proofs are short, but three public lemmas expose and use the unfolded definition of `ContractableLaw`, making the API and proofs depend on reducibility of the wrapper instead of the named predicate.
